description:
Use this when the user asks about an Indian company's splits, bonuses, dividends, buybacks or other corporate actions, past or announced. For events across the whole market use get_market_calendar.

Returns the company's corporate actions, newest ex-date first, including any announced with an ex-date in the coming weeks. `years` is 1 to 20 (default 5). `types` filters to a list drawn from: dividend, bonus, split, consolidation, rights, buyback, demerger, spinoff, merger, distribution, other. For dividends with yield use get_dividends; for events across the market, get_market_calendar.

query.description: One company: NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code, e.g. TCS, INE467B01029 or 532540. Always send it as `query` (not `symbol`).
query.title: Query
